name: Decorous Investment and Trading Company Limited

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price decline to ₹14.00, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 34.7x. Average trailing P/E is 25x in the Real Estate industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 28% over the past three years.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 21%
news.body: After last week's 21% share price gain to ₹13.55, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 33.5x. Average trailing P/E is 27x in the Real Estate industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 24% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.17 (vs ₹0.054 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.17 (up from ₹0.054 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.85m (up 40% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹589.2k (up 218% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 21% (up from 9.1% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 10% per year whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 12% per year.

news.title: Decorous Investment and Trading Company Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 09, 2026
news.body: Decorous Investment and Trading Company Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 09, 2026

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. No experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Non-Executive Non-Independent Director Amit Gupta is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2015. The company’s lack of experienced directors is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
